articles.title: What Cisco Stock Was Telling You About Its AI Orders
articles.summary: You could be forgiven for glancing at Cisco (CSCO)’s financials in early 2025 and promptly falling asleep. As of its fiscal third-quarter report for FY 2025 (July fiscal ending), trailing-twelve-month revenue had grown 0.5%. It was a picture of a mature tech titan, not a rocket ship.

articles.title: 3 Reasons to Sell CSCO and 1 Stock to Buy Instead
articles.summary: What a time it’s been for Cisco. In the past six months alone, the company’s stock price has increased by a massive 50.2%, reaching $110.66 per share. This was partly thanks to its solid quarterly results, and the performance may have investors wondering how to approach the situation.

articles.title: Cisco (CSCO) Tests Quantum Networking While Webex Adds AI Contact Center Partner
articles.summary: Cisco Systems is piloting Aliro Orchestrator as a quantum network management layer at its Photonics Center in Italy, using live quantum key distribution with Cisco routers. The company has also entered a new partnership with SuccessKPI to bring AI-powered workforce engagement and operational intelligence to Webex Contact Center. articles.title: Price Prediction: Cisco Stock Will Double on This Date
articles.summary: Cisco is up nearly 50% this year and just raised its AI order target by 80%, yet the stock sits well below its 52-week high. A bold model now maps a specific path to a price that would shock most analysts.
